end_debrief_title: End the current session and open the debrief
end_session_confirm_intro: This closes the case for debrief. Once ended:
end_session_confirm_locked: Orders, exams, and chat are locked.
end_session_confirm_transcript: You can review the transcript in the debrief room but cannot reopen the case.
multi_tab_warning: this session is open in another browser tab. Last-write-wins applies.
oyon_dashboard_load_failed: Could not load the Oyon dashboard
oyon_dashboard_truncated: capped at the most recent 1000 windows
oyon_reconsent_body: You previously agreed to camera-based emotion capture. Your institution now also wants to record how you work during a session. These are new kinds of information, so we are asking rather than assuming.
oyon_reconsent_decline: No, keep it as it is
oyon_reconsent_item_discourse: The style of the messages you send, such as whether you are asking or explaining.
oyon_reconsent_item_interaction: How you move around the screen — clicks, scrolling and which panel has your attention.
oyon_reconsent_item_typing: Typing rhythm in the message box — pauses and bursts, never the words you write.
oyon_reconsent_note: Analysis runs locally in your browser and only summaries are stored ({version}). Saying no keeps your existing emotion-capture choice exactly as it is, and you can change either one under Settings → Oyon.
